question: Can trait-specific or family-trait-specific observational/source-associated variation, calibrated without K outcomes, cause positive cross-family Blomberg K trait-rank portability even when the latent process is homogeneous stationary OU?

fixed_subgraph.rule: Remove seed_height solely because it prospectively failed the K-blind cross-source replication feasibility gate; no further empirical K-based exclusions. Compute every observed statistic again on exactly the same 12-trait graph used in the null.
fixed_subgraph.family_support: Retain families with >=2 trait systems; model and metric implementations must stop if any trait has <=1 families or 42 families are not preserved.

latent_evolution.model: Stationary OU with common global alpha, theta=0 and sigma2=1 across all family-trait systems, conditioned on exact original system trees and tip support.
latent_evolution.alpha_absolute_definition: alpha=c/T_ref with the original 508 tree-based T_ref=47.5820775; do not use any OU outcomes to alter c.

observation_heterogeneity.states: Y_tip = X_tip + epsilon_tip; epsilon iid Normal(0, sqrt(eta * Var_sample(X_tip))), per system, independent of X except for this sample-spread normalization.
observation_heterogeneity.source_error_role: eta is source-derived relative same-species cross-dataset dispersion; a stress-test observation heterogeneity envelope, not a direct instrument measurement-error estimate.

models.eta_rule: For all systems of a trait, use median of K-blind system ratios across source-qualified family systems, independently of observed K.

Use K-blind family×trait system relative source-dispersion ratio if source-qualified (>=5 multiple-positive-dataset species), otherwise impute the frozen trait_global ratio. No K-dependent imputation.

observation_heterogeneity.uncalibrated_trait_policy: Always exclude seed_height from both observed and simulated comparisons, retaining the complete 12-trait fixed subgraph; do not change model after source ratios are observed.
observation_heterogeneity.parameter_constraints: Require finite eta>=0 for each retained trait and system. Never cap extreme ratios after observing them; fail if invalid.

outcomes.primary: LOFO within-family rank prediction gain on frozen 12-trait graph, both tree axes.
secondary: Family random-intercept ICC conditional on named trait on identical 12-trait graph
outcomes.null_uncertainty: Empirical percentile of 256 replicate metrics, report q2.5, q97.5, and one-sided (1 + count(null>=observed))/257. Strong exceedance requires empirical rank gain > all six scenario q97.5 values on BOTH trees; report borderline p>=.025 separately.
outcomes.decision: If ANY pre-specified global OU+source noise scenario accommodates observed rank gain on EITHER tree, do not claim that rank portability requires process heterogeneity; if all 12 tests exceed, describe beyond the six tested independent stationary OU+source heterogeneity envelopes, not evidence of adaptation.

scientific_guards: Cross-dataset differences combine natural intraspecific, phenotypic plasticity, protocol and source effects and are not pure analytical error.
Do not claim the scenario set is exhaustive, or that measured source variation caused pattern matching.
The frozen observational K and source crosswalk are shared; this is a conditioned exploratory process-null comparison.
Trait covariance and source correlation among species remain unmodeled.
Process null frozen after observed rho, K and homogeneous OU outcomes; cannot be labelled a prospective discovery.
No model tuning on K, rank gain or ICC; no result-dependent removal or rescaling of traits.
